bible.title: The Toothless Heir
bible.kernel: A steward hires the company to find a runaway heir hiding in the western wood and bring them back to the fort.

cast.name: Quen
cast.who: steward of the house at the fort, blunt and bound to the family's pledge.
cast.want: to receive the missing heir at the fort so the house can swear its right.

cast.name: Clarry
cast.who: the runaway heir who has taken work as a cook among woodfolk, keeping to herself.
cast.want: to remain unreturned and keep living free as she is now.

cast.name: Eginthoril Windrow
cast.who: an elven warden raised on the ridgeline, practical and stubborn in his loyalties.
cast.want: to keep the cook from being forced back to the house.

bible.situation: Quen hires the company to find the missing heir last seen near the warden-stones. The heir, Clarry, fled into the western old-growth and now lives hidden among woodfolk as a cook. Eginthoril Windrow shelters her and refuses to let the house seize her without parley. The company must locate the trail, learn who trades with the hidden cook, secure Eginthoril's word to meet, and then bring Clarry to Quen at the fort.
bible.goal: to find and return the missing heir last seen near the warden-stones to Quen at the fort.
arc: Scout the warden-stones the client named for any sign the heir left behind → yields: a torn scrap of the house banner, chewed at the edge, and a faint trail toward Thistledell.

Follow the faint trail into Thistledell and question traders and woodfolk using the scrap as proof → yields: Terese, a traveling seller who bartered stew with a tall, toothless cook and points on to Ashwell Ruin.
Use Terese's direction to reach Ashwell Ruin and ask who sheltered the cook there → yields: Eginthoril Windrow, who admits sheltering the cook and promises to meet at the fort to parley.
Keep the meeting at the fort and press the pledge Eginthoril offered, taking Clarry to the client at Quen's feet → yields: Clarry handed over to Quen after the company outwits Eginthoril's refusal.
tensions: Eginthoril will refuse to hand the cook to outsiders without a firm pledge.
Clarry loathes her house and may resist being taken back.
Woodfolk dislike armed parties and may strike if the company forces a seizure.
openDirections: A rival house watches the absence and will press its claim if no heir is presented, buying allies and threats.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the house will lose its claim to the manor because no heir will appear to swear the family's pledge.
bible.arrival: walked in with the market crowd · would not name the place until the terms were set

shipped.title: Scout the warden-stones
shipped.situation: A steward, Quen, walked in with the market crowd and would not name where the heir was. Quen pushed back the offered chair and said the house must have the heir at the fort to swear its claim, the pay is honest coin, and any small spoils besides. They say the house will lose its claim to the manor if no heir appears to swear the pledge. The step is to scout the warden-stones for any sign the heir left behind. A warden plans to hold the warden-stones and keep the cook from being forced back to the house.
shipped.job: Search the warden-stones for any sign the heir left behind.
